thread.title: Apple hires Golden State Warriors exec as events director

author: John Lombardo
title: Apple hires Golden State Warriors exec as events director
text: Mar 13, 2018, 1:54pm PDT Updated Mar 13, 2018, 2:44pm PDT Apple Inc. is reaching into the sports business industry for talent as the company hires Gail Hunter away from the Golden State Warriors. The team's vice president of public affairs and event management, Hunter played a key role in community outreach as the Warriors sought to build a new $1 billion Chase Center arena and office mid-rises, initially along the Embarcadero, and now under construction in Mission Bay. The arena is scheduled to be completed in August 2019. Hunter, whose last day with the Warriors is Friday, is the second departure from the team's executive suites since the start of the year. The Miami Marlins last month said they hired Chip Bowers, the Warriors' chief marketing officer, as president of business operations. Hunter, who was hired by the Warriors in 2012 after 13 years with the National Basketball Association, will join Cupertino-based Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) as director of events on March 19, according to the team. The iPhone maker will host its Worldwide Developer Conference in San Jose again this year, from June 4-9. Hunter was not available for comment.
